retrievalProfile.description: A multi-panel layout featuring a large duotone photograph, a white header for display type, and a vertical sidebar for track listings.
triggerTerms: condensed sans-serif display type with alternating colors

recipe.visualDefinition: A structured grid-based composition divided into three distinct zones: a top horizontal white bar for the main title, a left vertical white column for secondary text, and a large rectangular duotone image area on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Top-heavy display typography balanced by a large photographic subject
Vertical blue divider line separating the text column from the image
Alternating color rhythm in the main title text
High-contrast duotone image processing against a solid color background
coreInvariants: The use of a vertical divider line between the left text column and the main image area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a group portrait occupying the bottom-right two-thirds of the frame, scaled to fill the yellow-tinted rectangle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, condensed display title at the top left serves as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large title at the top, down the left-hand list, and finally across to the group portrait on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space in the top header and left column provides breathing room for the dense photographic area.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Yellow (duotone base for the image area)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sky Blue (divider line and alternating text color)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation backgrounds contrasted with high-contrast black-and-white photographic elements.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed display sans-serif paired with a bold italicized sans-serif for lists.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the narrow, high-impact display style of the header.
Matches the sturdy, functional feel of the sidebar list.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a three-panel layout: a white top horizontal bar, a white left vertical column, and a large yellow-tinted rectangular area on the right. Place a high-contrast black and white group portrait inside the yellow area. Add a thin blue vertical line between the left column and the yellow area.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large condensed sans-serif text in the top bar, alternating colors between blue and orange for each word. In the left column, add a list of text in bold italicized black sans-serif, centered within the column.

verificationChecks: Is the title text condensed and multi-colored?
Is there a clear vertical blue divider line?
Is the image area a duotone yellow/black?
Is the left-hand text italicized and uppercase?

adjustableVariables: Width of the left text column
Color of the alternating title text
mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top right circle
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the vertical divider line is perfectly straight.
Check that the duotone image maintains clear facial features.
Verify the alternating color pattern in the header is consistent.
Confirm the sidebar text is centered within its white column.
recipe.reuseFormula: Grid(Header:White, Sidebar:White, Content:Duotone) + Type(Display:Condensed_Sans, List:Bold_Italic_Sans) + Detail(Vertical_Divider_Line)
